challengerValidation.note: Shadow forecasts never change published percentages or picks. Evaluated years are model-selection data, not an independent blind prospective test.

shadowForwardPerformance.source: Immutable pregame XGBoost challenger picks; ties and late/backfilled entries excluded

forecastRevisionSummary.note: Only original timestamped picks and later forecasts saved before the actual kickoff are scored. Recovered originals retain their original observation time and import provenance. Last recorded does not necessarily mean near kickoff; a separate 24-hour cohort reports true late updates. Ties excluded. No retrospective injury estimates.

predictionRecord.note: These are real timestamped forward predictions, NOT historical backtests. Every game counts once, irrespective of saved revisions. Original picks never change. Latest means the last actually recorded pre-kickoff pick, not necessarily a game-day estimate. Only official final scores available in nflverse schedules are graded; tied, unplayed, and unverified matches are excluded. Accuracy is favourite-pick win rate. Brier and log loss measure probability quality, and lower is better. Sample sizes below 30 are preliminary.

playerEffectScorecard.note: Research only. Each game is graded once using the latest genuinely timestamped, fresh, applied player adjustment BEFORE kickoff and its saved same-time non-player probability. Brier gain = without-player error minus adjusted error, so positive is better. Categories can overlap in combined games. Stale cached effects and old snapshots lacking a saved same-time counterfactual are excluded. Any 100-game/two-season threshold triggers independent review, never automatic approval, confidence or a betting signal.
